findings.title: Design D3 still states the broad suffix rule walk 2 narrowed in the spec
findings.recommendation: Replace D3's 'strip `:<line>…`' with the narrowed rule the gate requirement now states (a trailing `:<line>` or `:<line>:<column>`, digits only, through the reused `stripLineSuffix`), and keep the measurement: re-run under the narrow rule, the figure is unchanged (1 unresolved of 1350 recorded `file`/`ripple_cascade.applied` paths since 2026-09-20, the same free-text entry).

walk_entry.title: The promised suffix rule is not the function tasks reuse

commentary: Walk 2's five edits were read in the diff from the external return's commit (d1a01ba9) and checked against both owners. W1's moved example is now a genuine scope miss: the body file sits outside the change directory and the entry's other scope members. W2 and walk 1's status-only refusal now bind different things (the payload being written; records on disk), and the two requirements say so. W3's normalization is stated once in the gate requirement and pointed at from the shape. W5's narrowing reached design Goals, Non-Goals, Risks, the proposal and the architecture doc's SPLIT paragraph and rc08b charter. W4 stopped one site short: design D3 restates the path rule in its broad form. The residual check found no file changed outside walk 2's edit records.
